'''Adar 10 (April 22)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{Ne|998}} - [[Perrin Aybara]] and [[Egwene al'Vere]] take refuge in an abandoned ''[[stedding]]''. They are captured by [[Whitecloak]]s led by [[Geofram Bornhald]]. [[Hopper]] is killed. [[Elyas Machera]] escapes. [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Matrim Cauthon]] work and stay the night at Grinwell's farm.
*{{ne|1000}} - [[Furyk Karede]] reaches Matrim Cauthon's camp near the [[Malvide Narrows]]. Mat agrees to let him take [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag|Tuon]] back to [[Ebou Dar]]. Tuon completes the [[Seanchan]] marriage ritual. [[Chel Vanin]] arrives with news of ten thousand soldiers nearby. Mat ambushes the soldiers and wipes them out. [[Musenge]] takes the head of a Seanchan traitor, [[Zaired Elbar]], back to Ebou Dar. Mat learns that by marrying Tuon, he is now [[The Prince of the Ravens]].<noinclude>
